1.text: Indirimbo ya Dawidi y'Amazamuka.Narishimye ubwo bambwiraga bati“Tujye mu nzu y'Uwiteka.”

2.text: Yerusalemu,Ibirenge byacu bihagaze mu marembo yawe.

4.text: Aho imiryango izamuka ijya,Ari yo miryango y'Uwiteka,Kugira ngo babe abagabo bo guhamiriza Abisirayeli,Kandi bashime izina ry'Uwiteka.

5.text: Kuko ari ho batereka intebe z'imanza,Intebe z'inzu ya Dawidi.

6.text: Nimusabire i Yerusalemu amahoro,“Abagukunda bagubwe neza.

7.text: Amahoro abe imbere y'inkike zawe,Kugubwa neza kube mu nyumba zawe.”

8.text: Ku bwa bene data na bagenzi banjye,None ndavuga nti “Amahoro abe muri wowe.”

9.text: Ku bw'inzu y'Uwiteka Imana yacu,Nzajya ngushakira ibyiza.
